jobs.name: OpenRouter Top 5 Daily Update
jobs.prompt:
Update the top 5 LLM models data at /tmp/openrouter-dashboard/data.json by scraping the OpenRouter rankings page.

Steps:
1. Navigate to https://openrouter.ai/rankings using browser_navigate
2. Wait 8 seconds for the page to fully load and render the LLM Leaderboard data
3. Extract the top 5 models from the LLM Leaderboard section by reading the page's rendered text
4. Format the data as JSON matching this structure:
{
  "lastUpdated": "<current ISO timestamp>",
  "period": "This Week",
  "source": "https://openrouter.ai/rankings",
  "topModels": [
    {"rank": 1, "name": "...", "author": "...", "tokens": "3.21T", "growth": 73},
    ...
  ]
}
5. Write this JSON to /tmp/openrouter-dashboard/data.json using write_file (overwrite)
6. Then cd /tmp/openrouter-dashboard and run: git add data.json && git commit -m "chore: update openrouter top 5 rankings data" && git push
7. Verify the push succeeded

jobs.name: Daily 6AM News Briefing + HTML
jobs.prompt:
You are generating today's daily news briefing. Follow these steps.

## STEP 1: Fetch news from all 4 RSS feeds
Load the get-news skill first. Fetch and clean articles from these feeds:
- Malaysia: https://www.malaymail.com/feeds/rss (use web_search or curl)
- Global: https://rss.nytimes.com/services/xml/rss/nyt/World.xml
- Iran-US: https://rss.nytimes.com/services/xml/rss/nyt/MiddleEast.xml
- Tech/AI: https://hnrss.org/frontpage

Parse each RSS feed to extract title, link, and description for each article. Clean titles by removing the trailing source name (e.g., " - Malay Mail", " - The New York Times"). Strip HTML tags and entities from descriptions. Select the best 5 articles per feed (20 total) — prefer substance over clickbait.

## STEP 2: Generate styled HTML page
Create a standalone HTML page at /tmp/news_briefing_$(date +%Y_%m_%d).html using the site design language from the html-publishing skill (dark navy header with blue accent, white card sections, responsive layout). Include:
- Date as title
- 4 sections (🇲🇾 Malaysia, 🌍 Global, 🇮🇷🇺🇸 Iran-US, 💻 Tech/AI)
- Each article as a white card with: bold linked title, summary text
- A backlink to index.html at the top
- Footer with "Generated by Hermes Agent"

## STEP 3: Publish to GitHub Pages
The GitHub Pages repo is at /tmp/fahmi_github_io/ (remote: git@github.com:fahmiamni/reports.git, published at https://fahmiamni.github.io/reports/).
VERIFY the remote URL before pushing.
Copy the HTML file there, update index.html with a new card entry at the top of the News section, commit and push.

## STEP 4: Deliver ONLY the link via Telegram
Your final delivery message to the user should be ONLY:
📰 *Daily News Briefing — $(date +"%B %d, %Y")*
[Read the full briefing here](https://fahmiamni.github.io/reports/news_briefing_$(date +%Y_%m_%d).html)

Do NOT include any article summaries, bullet points, or news content in the Telegram message. The link alone is sufficient — the user will read it on the page.
